definitions.explanation: A formal exchange of questions and answers, typically following a presentation, lecture, or meeting. A four-character compound combining 質疑 (questioning) and 応答 (response).

examples.japanese: {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ります→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: We will now move to the Q&A session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a Q&A session after the lecture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{及|およ}んだ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧。
examples.english: The question-and-answer session in the assembly went on for as long as three hours.

notes:
USAGE:
{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう} is used in formal or semi-formal contexts such as presentations, conferences, parliamentary sessions, and press conferences. It is a yojijukugo combining ⟦{質疑|しつぎ}→質疑：20270_shitsugi⟧ (questioning/inquiry) and ⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧ (response).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (Q&A time)
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ (to respond to questions)
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to conduct a Q&A session)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ is the everyday word for a question. {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう} specifically refers to the structured back-and-forth format, not a single question.
